root_cause: Existing tenant-proof and connector metadata fetches already rejected stale users, but a pending /api/portaalvraag answer and browser SpeechRecognition onresult/onerror path could still display or act after logout, account switch or close; browser abort did not guarantee callback invalidation.
prevention_rule: For original Portal V2 voice use monotone request epoch and current verified identity after every async assistant await, for both errors and successful answers. Invalidate on each new command, logout/account switch, modal close and destroy. Speech callbacks must compare recognizer instance, microphone epoch, original principal and open dialog before applying transcript or error. Never auto-invoke privileged actions, emit external alerts, create a parallel worker/sender, or promote CI to production without independent browser readback.
regression_contract: Historically reproduce in-flight assistant after identity A-to-B, logout, modal close, or superseding question; stale answer/error must be invisible. Late speech onresult/onerror after recognizer abort/dialog close/identity switch must be discarded. Ensure native approvals, safe typed fallback, opt-in and tenant status continue unchanged.
